title: Dawn at KR Market flower lane
text: Go at 5:30 am when trucks unload - the colours and haggling are unreal. Hold your phone tight.
author: Seeded tip

title: Malleshwaram breakfast crawl
text: Veena Stores -> CTR -> filter coffee. Do it before 9 am on a weekday and you'll skip the queues.
author: Seeded tip

title: Sunday sunrise at Lalbagh rock
text: Walk up to the Kempegowda tower for sunrise; mist plus the skyline is lovely.
author: Seeded tip

title: Startup meetups beyond the big ones
text: The best talks are small: community-run dev and design meetups in coworking spaces, often announced only in group chats.
author: Seeded tip
